CHAPTER 01

Raw

Every finished surface begins as an irregular field: granular, uncommitted, and full of possible structures.

CHAPTER 02

Pressure

Force removes the empty distance between particles. The material learns the outline of its constraint.

CHAPTER 03

Heat

At temperature, boundaries soften. Separate grains exchange matter until the joins can no longer be found.

CHAPTER 04

Form

The final object carries its process quietly: density, compression, and time resolved into a precise edge.
